name: verifiable-certificates-yarn
description: Commands that must pass after any change, one per eligibility requirement so a failure names the requirement. None needs credentials or a .env. Install reaches the package registry and the GitHub releases that host the prebuilt Askar, AnonCreds and zstd binaries; nothing else touches the network.

commands.name: install
commands.purpose: Install every workspace from the committed lockfile, without changing it.

commands.name: lint
commands.purpose: ESLint in every workspace, zero warnings.

commands.name: test
commands.purpose: SDK and app tests against an in-memory Hedera (deterministic, no network, no credentials).

commands.name: build
commands.purpose: SDK type build and Next.js production build.
